findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous function calls in pydantic
 * @description Finds calls to eval/exec, pickle, os.system/popen, subprocess and importlib with dynamic names
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pydantic-dangerous-calls
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string kind
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() and kind = "pickle deserialization"
    or
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and kind = "eval/exec code execution"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "execv", "execvp"]).getACall() and kind = "os command execution"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen", "getoutput"]).getACall() and kind = "subprocess execution"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember("import_module").getACall() and kind = "dynamic import"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and kind = "builtins eval/exec"
  )
select call, kind
findings.hypothesis: Dangerous primitives (eval/exec, pickle, subprocess, dynamic import) exist in the package and may be reachable from untrusted input

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential ReDoS regular expressions
 * @description Finds regular expression literals with nested/unbounded quantifiers that may cause catastrophic backtracking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pydantic-redos-regex
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string pat
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "fullmatch"]).getACall()
  and pat = call.getArg(0).asExpr().(Str).getText()
  and pat.regexpMatch(".*\\([^()]*[+*][^()]*\\)\\s*[+*].*")
select call, "Regex with nested quantifier (possible ReDoS): " + pat
findings.hypothesis: CVE-2024-3772 style ReDoS: regexes with nested quantifiers compiled at import time or used in validators

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ReDoS regexes in source
 * @description Finds regex literals containing nested quantifiers that may cause catastrophic backtracking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos-scan
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python

from Str s, string text
where
  text = s.getText() and
  text.length() > 2 and
  (
    text.regexpMatch(".*\\([^()]*[+*][^()]*\\)[+*].*") or
    text.regexpMatch(".*\\([^()]*[+*][^()]*\\)\\{[0-9,]+\\}.*")
  ) and
  exists(Call c |
    c.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = ["compile", "match", "search", "fullmatch", "sub", "findall"] and
    c.getArg(0) = s
  )
select s, "Potential ReDoS pattern: " + text
findings.hypothesis: Nested-quantifier regexes used in pydantic validators may allow ReDoS on attacker-controlled input (CWE-1333)

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name String literals in v2 networks
 * @description Lists string literals in pydantic/networks.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/strlit-networks
 */

import python

from Str s
where
  s.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "pydantic/networks.py" and
  s.getLocation().getStartLine() > 390 and
  s.getLocation().getStartLine() < 430
select s, "literal: " + s.getText()
findings.hypothesis: Identify the exact regex used in pydantic/networks.py reached by user input (EmailStr/@-validation) to confirm ReDoS exposure

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Parameter tainted dangerous sinks
 * @description Find eval/exec/importlib/pickle sinks reachable from a function parameter via local taint
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-sinks-from-params
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node n) {
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode c |
    c = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and n = c.getArg(0)
    or
    c = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember(["import_module", "reload"]).getACall() and n = c.getArg(0)
    or
    c = API::moduleImport(["pickle", "dill", "marshal", "jsonpickle"]).getMember(["loads", "load", "Unpickler"]).getACall() and n = c.getArg(0)
    or
    c = API::moduleImport("__import__").getACall() and n = c.getArg(0)
  )
}

from DataFlow::Node src, DataFlow::Node sink
where
  isSink(sink) and
  TaintTracking::localTaint(src, sink) and
  src instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
select sink, "Tainted by parameter: " + src.(DataFlow::ParameterNode).getParameter().getName() + " $@", src, "param"
findings.hypothesis: Dangerous sinks (eval/exec/import/pickle) reachable from function parameters

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regex compile call sites
 * @description Lists regex compilation sites with literal patterns to map validators
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/regex-call-sites
 */

import python

from Call c, string text
where
  c.getFunc().(Attribute).getAttr() = ["compile", "match", "search", "fullmatch"]
  and c.getArg(0).(Str).getText() = text
select c, "regex: " + text + " in " + c.getLocation().getFile().getBaseName()
findings.hypothesis: Enumerate regex call sites to identify attacker-reachable validation patterns
Function parameters in validator modules flow into regex match/search calls, enabling ReDoS when regexes have nested quantifiers.
